challenge.description: Micro-oscillation under servo duty drives fretting wear on the flexspline tooth flank, the core harmonic-drive failure mode.

challenge_evidence.statement: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the recorded grease duty profile states +/-3 deg oscillation at 5 Hz and 10e6 cycles for contract testing only.
